invariants.rationale: The method always returns the output of HoodieMergeHandleFactory.create, which should not be null under normal operation.
The instantTime is used as an argument for creating a handle and should be non-null and non-empty for valid updates.
The fileId is used as an identifier and passed to the factory, so it must be non-null and non-empty.
partitionPath identifies the partition and is passed to the factory; it must be non-null and non-empty.
keyToNewRecords is always accessed and passed to the factory, so it should not be null.
